meta.note: Monday edition. Three top stories: Section 301 exclusions expire 11-09 — 7-day countdown (no extension notice; USTR's 10-26 proposal only extends the maritime port-fee suspension, still not finalized, and does not cover product exclusions); power MOSFET/discrete lead times stretched to 48-104+ weeks, some on allocation; SK hynix Q3 DRAM ASP up 20%+ QoQ, 14 long-term contracts locking in over half of 27-28 capacity. Tech & partnerships: Trane 800V DC chiller lab demo, Daikin iCM PRO launched 11-01, Shenling CDU patent grant, JCI high-temperature heat pump at Gulfood, Carrier $3B long-term agreement + 10% price increase, Infineon 27kW 800V DC power reference design. Siphon effects: memory/advanced packaging, MLCC's new price-hike round (Samsung Electro-Mechanics AI high-capacitance +50-80%, Taiyo Yuden consumer high-capacitance +50-150%, Yageo's second channel repricing), power semiconductors, copper 14,230. Cross-industry: PV/storage price hikes (Huawei/Kehua +5-15%), Allegro current sensors' second price increase (rare earths cited in the increase letter for the first time). Event library: 77 to 83 (6 new events: Trane 800V DC, Daikin iCM PRO, Shenling CDU patent, Huawei/Kehua PV-storage price hike, Allegro price hike, Fusion MOSFET lead times; 7 timeline entries added; fixed duplicate id evt-invt-vsd-price-hike). Tier B batch 1 (first batch of round 3): no anomalies across 11 categories. English edition: generated by the 09:00 translation cron.

hotspot_events.title: 178 Section 301 product exclusions expire 11-09 (ET) — 7-day countdown, still no extension notice
hotspot_events.heat_reason: 7-day action window, cross-confirmed by multiple sources; after expiry Lists 1-3 revert to 25% and 4A to 7.5%, directly raising US-lane procurement costs
hotspot_events.summary: As of 11-02, USTR has not issued an extension for the 178 product-exclusion provisions (expiring 11-09 23:59 ET). On 10-26 USTR only published a proposal to extend the maritime port-fee suspension (proposed through 2027-01-09; comment period closed 10-30, no final notice yet), and the proposal does not cover product exclusions.

industry_updates.title: Trane, Eaton and Danfoss complete lab demo of 800V DC chiller
industry_updates.detail: Retrofitted high-efficiency chiller delivering ~1,000 refrigeration tons (~3.5MW) of cooling; direct DC operation cuts power-conversion stages, lifting efficiency by up to ~2%; two 250MW reference designs on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory platform released in parallel (lab/design stage, not customer deliveries)

industry_updates.title: Daikin Europe launches iCM PRO smart chiller control platform (launched 11-01)

industry_updates.title: Shenling Environmental granted utility-model patent for 'coolant distribution unit and liquid-cooled cabinet'
industry_updates.detail: Patent no. CN224909948U (2026-10-27); addresses insufficient coolant flow-regulation capability, covering primary/secondary heat-exchange modules and multi-point temperature/pressure sensing
industry_updates.source: Sina Finance / China National Intellectual Property Administration, 2026-10-31

industry_updates.title: JCI brings Sabroe HitemHP high-temperature heat pump to Gulfood Manufacturing 2026 in Dubai
industry_updates.detail: Up to 122 deg C process heat at ~3x the efficiency of electric boilers, for industrial refrigeration and low-carbon process heating in food & beverage manufacturing; expo runs 11-03 to 11-05

industry_updates.title: Carrier Q3 earnings call: $3B+ long-term agreement, 10% price increase, Fort Worth capacity doubling under construction
